test_environment: Embedded Chromium document. Direct local HTTP browser navigation was blocked by the execution environment, so the HTML, CSS and JavaScript were assembled into a self-contained preview. External Google Fonts and live-host transport were not tested; the smoke test neutralized local media sources. The separate preview render embeds local image assets for visual review.
limitations: The test does not establish compatibility across every browser/device.
Hero video playback and external font delivery were not tested in the embedded smoke test.
Physical Android/iOS testing, live-host response-header verification and Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals remain outstanding.
The contact form remains a client-side mailto draft and is not a server-backed submission endpoint.
